availability_rule: Retain provider announcementTime and official attachment archive date separately. They must agree on China calendar date. Use next-day 00:00:00 +08:00 as conservative date-only availability, never infer first-publication seconds from a midnight provider field. Only availability <= snapshot is eligible.
limitations: This is the existing retrospective 123-company mechanism-development cohort, not the separate fresh-v3 126-company cohort or an unseen validation population.
Current official archive is not certified as unchanged historical bytes.
Report date is not public availability; bank/broker fields require separate applicability and unit checks.
2019 annual reports published after the cutoff are ineligible even though the report year is 2019.
Unknown or ambiguous reports remain explicit QC states; missing financial values cannot be zero-filled.
selection_rule: Query every member of the frozen 123-company mechanism-development cohort, without returns or semantic labels. Preserve all candidate announcements. For each period prefer full text, then plain report, then report body; exclude summaries, English versions and ancillary announcements. Within preferred form choose latest eligible version; retain revision status. Equal-date competing documents are ambiguous and not silently selected.
stage_scope: Formal source inventory and batch raw acquisition, not verified financial values or prediction increment. Current identity is a retrieval crosswalk, not a historical Agent feature.
